searchText: > – The "MPT of txs" is essentially an "MPT of txHashes", having a GeneralizedIndex available that exposes the txHash could be useful to store extra, to allow proving non-HTR txHashes (future hashing algos?) The MPT of txs would be a backwards-compatibility thing only, I would argue that it should *only* store legacy, 2930 and 1559 transactions and not even store the newer ones at all (and eventually it should be retired) As far as onions go, this was my intent in saying "the precise definition of `Union` is still a topic of discussion"; there's a few different ways of doing it and we should probably discuss more to figure out the best one Early outline for overall SSZ transition EIP (not just tx) I started during interop: https://github.com/etan-status/EIPs/blob/el-ssz/EIPS/eip-draft_ssz.md Ideally, would combine tx / receipts into it as well (or, combine the withdrawals into a pre-existing tx/receipts EIP)

excerpts.content:
> – The "MPT of txs" is essentially an "MPT of txHashes", having a GeneralizedIndex available that exposes the txHash could be useful to store extra, to allow proving non-HTR txHashes (future hashing algos?)

The MPT of txs would be a backwards-compatibility thing only, I would argue that it should *only* store legacy, 2930 and 1559 transactions and not even store the newer ones at all (and eventually it should be retired)

excerpts.author: .vbuterin
excerpts.content: As far as onions go, this was my intent in saying "the precise definition of `Union` is still a topic of discussion"; there's a few different ways of doing it and we should probably discuss more to figure out the best one

Early outline for overall SSZ transition EIP (not just tx) I started during interop: https://github.com/etan-status/EIPs/blob/el-ssz/EIPS/eip-draft_ssz.md
Ideally, would combine tx / receipts into it as well (or, combine the withdrawals into a pre-existing tx/receipts EIP)
